en.html:
Silver Star departed. I returned my gaze to the ground.

...A dying tsurugi lay huddled there.

Muramasa was pitiful to look at. Warped, twisted, bent—as though she had fallen from a mountain peak and then endured a rain of rocks.

The crimson armor now looked to me like bloodied flesh.

　……瀕死の劒冑が<ruby>蹲<rt>うずくま</rt></ruby>っている。

　村正は、見るも無残な姿と化していた。

の雨を浴びればかくもなろうか。

　深紅の甲鉄が、今は血塗れの肉膚と目に映る。

en.html:
I had considered that more than once.

And each time, given it up. Ordinary tsurugi would be eaten by the eggs. To fight Silver Star, there was no alternative to using this cursed armor—so I had concluded.

I had used Muramasa in resignation.

Resignation.

Not because I wanted her. Never that.

　そしていつも、断念してきたのだった。
　並の劒冑では〝卵〟に食われてしまうのだから仕方
がない。銀星号と戦うには、この呪わしい劒冑を使い
続ける以外にない――と。

　そう諦めて、村正を使ってきたのだ。

　<ruby>諦めて<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>。

　望んだのでは、決してなく。

en.html:
Muramasa.

Emotional for a tsurugi, often agitated and shaken. A strong self of her own. Sometimes she disobeyed, sometimes made difficulties.

Just now, she had even attempted to wield her power against me.

And the law of good and evil offset. This tsurugi would always make battle fruitless.

...That was Muramasa.

My tsurugi.
With whom I had shared the road for two years.

en.html:
Kageaki"All killing is the work of an evil demon."
Kageaki"There are no exceptions. There is no justice in any killing."
Kageaki"There is no justice in battle."
Muramasa《...My lord...》
Kageaki"Muramasa. You taught me that."
Kageaki"Had I bound myself to another tsurugi and fought these two years... perhaps by now I would consider myself a hero."
Kageaki"A righteous warrior fighting and destroying evil to save the people. And after defeating Silver Star, perhaps I would be thinking of overthrowing Rokuhara also..."
Kageaki"A dreadful thought, even to imagine it. Drunk on justice that was only self-righteousness wearing makeup, and starting a war..."
Muramasa《............》
Kageaki"Muramasa. There is no justice in me."
Kageaki"I never want to forget that truth. So I need you."
Kageaki"If I threw you away for another tsurugi... I would be choosing the self-righteous path of spare the good, kill the evil."
Kageaki"Admitting that some people may die and others must not—and that I have the right to distinguish them..."
